contacts.signature: Guess if I'm short on the Metal element in my astrological chart?

150810101.text: "To the great Nameless, Arbiter of the wispae's destiny..."

150810102.text: "Have you ever imagined that those game consoles of ours, the ones that absolutely adore you, would follow you all the way to Astropolis?"

150810103.text: "Just kidding. There's obviously a reason for that, and it's not quite as absurd as that little joke made it sound."

150810104.text: "I'm afraid I won't be able to explain it in detail with just a simple message, which is why I'd like you to pay a visit to a member of our secret club, Astropolis's very own language maestro, Little Kumā."

150810105.text: (P.S. Don't send out the stuff written in parentheses this time!)
